title: Refund processing for digital orders
acceptance_criteria: 1. POST /refunds creates a refund record and returns 201 with the refund id
2. Refunds exceeding the order total are rejected with 422 and a validation message
3. Every refund over $100 writes an audit log entry (actor, amount, order id) BEFORE the payment-provider call is made
4. A regression test covers the over-total rejection path (criterion 2)
notes: Audit logging (criterion 3) is a compliance requirement — the ticket is not done without it.
